mapping.read_slot_formula: 8 first-layer tiles x5 input bits +2 second-layer tiles x8 hidden bits; no zero-plane skipping.
mapping.note: Logical placement and bit-plane algebra. Tiles may share one physical array by reprogramming. Memory buffers, timing, read-induced state evolution and transistor/interconnect effects are not simulated.

scope: Both layers have binary weights; pixels remain multibit and hidden activations are8-bit digital values. No extra device conductance levels.
Same four histories, five short snapshots and seeds0..99 assignment policy; maps extend to the two new matrix shapes.
Digital positive output gains and biases are frozen across every hardware scenario; no history-specific recalibration.
All test scenarios are frozen-state snapshots;56 logical read slots do not establish retention for that full sequence or450 sequential images.
Readout and wires are ideal.8-bit hidden conversion is a chosen numerical operation, not measured peripheral hardware accuracy. No new COMSOL solve or memory-latency claim.
The reused450-image test cohort is for comparison, not a new independent cohort. No test-score-based model selection. Scenario means are not hardware yield probabilities.
Continuous hidden control is the200-epoch initializer refitted on all training data at the binary-selected seed; not a claim of optimal continuous-network accuracy.

One adaptive checkpoint-policy correction followed the initial unstable run. Initial82.67% test result is archived, not discarded. Corrected configuration/budget selection uses inner validation and training losses only; the reused test set was already observed, so this is exploratory evaluation, not a fresh independent test.
